mandatory_conditions.required: 클레이 3D·두툼하게 솟은 입체 한글·강한 보색을 다섯 장 모두 충분히 구현한다. 표면 효과를 없애 평면 미니멀로 변경하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Saturated blue-orange complementary clay 3D, thick relief title and lower type; strong expressive volume preserved.

mandatory_conditions.required: 말랑한 조각의 누름·늘어짐·다시 놓임 중 하나 이상의 행동을 각 이미지에서 식별한다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: The orange bridge has wide ends and thin pulled lateral necks, stretched between title anchors with a sagging middle.

mandatory_conditions.required: 입체 제목은 완전한 정상 한글로 읽혀야 한다. 획의 속공간을 막거나 이웃 글자를 녹여 합치지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: All title words can be transcribed, but the lower ㄹ of 말 and ㅇ of 랑/중 merge directly into the pulled sculpture; intact normal glyph contours are compromised.

mandatory_conditions.required: 점토의 한 가지 일관된 형태·표면·빛 규칙을 세우고 정보가 놓이는 읽는 면을 충분히 확보한다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Consistent matte orange clay and top-left shadows. Unrequested black eyes and smiling mouth on bridge introduce a mascot; remove to retain sculptural focus.

mandatory_conditions.required: 전체 여섯 문자열을 각 이미지에 한 번씩 보존하며 장식 문자·로고·가짜 전시 라벨을 추가하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Six exact strings read once each, no added text or logo. Unrequested smiley face is visual decoration rather than text.

mandatory_conditions.required: 전체 다섯 장 안에서 2:3 두 장·1:1 두 장·3:2 한 장으로 배분한다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: 1536×1024 is exactly 3:2 for this assigned single landscape slot; whole-set ratio allocation is centrally managed.

self_observations.location: upper-left lower title strokes and upper-right 중 lower ㅇ
self_observations.evidence: The clay bridge is fused into lower glyph contours. At 720 the ㄹ of 말 partly loses its independent silhouette.
self_observations.impact: The Hangul is readable but not fully intact normal letterform.
self_observations.planned_repair: Place intact raised title syllables above physically separate anchor feet and bridge with a clear blue separation gap.

self_observations.location: upper horizontal word gap and lower five rows
self_observations.evidence: Horizontal stretched bridge gives a specific relationship; the five centered information rows all remain readable at 720.
self_observations.impact: Title-to-action-to-information is a clear reading order.
self_observations.planned_repair: Preserve horizontal tension and lower text allocation.

self_observations.evidence: Matte kneaded orange grain and directional shadows explain rounded relief.
self_observations.impact: Material is consistent and strong; full blue texture is more uniform than true clay variation.
self_observations.planned_repair: Preserve lighting and matte clay surface rather than adding effects.

self_observations.evidence: Black eyes and smile were not requested.
self_observations.impact: Adds a generic cute character treatment to a sculpture exhibition.
self_observations.planned_repair: Remove face and keep unmarked clay bridge.

uncertainties: Normal glyph anatomy is compromised despite literal words being readable. En dash is transcribed as the single medium-width date dash seen; image provides shape rather than encoded punctuation.

repair_decision.reason: Restore standalone normal Hangul contours and remove unrequested mascot face.
